note: Chebyshev fixed-batch lower bounds (2026-10-27; CONTRIBUTING §5.2 rule 6, before v0.1). The fixed-batch Frobenius and nuclear minimax arguments are stated for a general level spectrum (`NLAlib.levelSpectrum`: head L, tail levels ν_j ∈ [0, τ]) with an extrapolation constant C (`NLAlib.IsExtrapolationControl`) and a Gaussian deviation γ with 36C ≤ (γ − 2)²; the equispaced instance (C = 4^{r+1}, γ = 8·2^{r+1}) recovers the previous statements, and the equispaced headline query bounds keep their statements. The new Chebyshev instance (head 1 + 1/(8(r+1)²), Chebyshev tail levels in [1/2, 1], C = 4, γ = 14) gives q > k/(12544(r+1)³ε). Lemmas that named the equispaced spectrum and now hold for every level spectrum are renamed (rule N4); mul_exp_neg_div_lt_half takes its Gaussian factor as an argument and, now a general fact, moves to ForMathlib as Real.mul_exp_neg_div_lt_half (rule P9).
